pathSyntax: dot-separated segments; a numeric segment indexes an array; the leaf value is compared with deep JSON equality
factSelector: a fact selects the chain event by spanId when present; otherwise by kind+nodeKey+status (S5 convention). Derived '#trace.*' facts need no selector.
derivedPathSyntax: paths starting with '#trace.' are computed over the whole source before fact lookup: spanCount, backendSpanCount, valuesSpanCount, valuesLength (items on the reconcileLoop span), valuesTotalFlag (integer after VALUES_TOTAL=), valuesCappedFlag (integer after VALUES_CAPPED=), droppedEqualsTotalMinusLength, noSilentDrop, firstValueFrom, lastValueTo, badValueCount (items with from!==null && to===0), badValueIndexes, retainedOrderAscending (observation order preserved), allItemsTruncatedFalse, allInvocationOne, valueLineSet, graphNodeKeyCount
note: S6b loop fixture ONLY. This file is deterministic contract shape, NOT runtime evidence: the real ~102 observations, the folded 20-item list, the VALUES_CAPPED/VALUES_TOTAL counts and the retained 50 -> 0 bad value must come from demo L2DemoService#reconcileLoop + the javaagent L2Values folding E2E (S6B-C). Never cite this directory as proof of runtime folding, of full loop recording, of sampling rates or of L2 overhead. The 82/102 numbers are a shape example: runtime tests assert t>20, d=t-20, length=20 and never hard-code total. Line numbers are illustrative; tests recompute the init/increment/reset lines from L2DemoService.java.

runtimeProbeExpectations.probes: 4 probes measured with JDK8 javap (init baseline line, increment line, if/reset line, anchor line; the for-line boundary is skipped because the previous instruction is if_icmpgt); the transformer self-check accepts >=2, logs the actual count in l2_probes_installed and fail-opens with l2_probe_missing below 2; tests never hard-assert 3
runtimeProbeExpectations.anchor: the anchor statement reads local without changing it; it is what makes the post-reset 0 observable at the next line boundary (the reset write happens on the if line, the changed value is observed at the following boundary/anchor)
runtimeProbeExpectations.observations: about 102 changes for times=100: null->0 baseline, 49 increments, 49->50 and 50->0 at i=50, 0->1 recovery, then 49 increments to 50
runtimeProbeExpectations.fold: first 6 + last 6 + middle uniform samples to fill 20, and the first bad value (from!==null && to===0) is always kept; retained items stay in original observation order
runtimeProbeExpectations.noRecompute: retained from/to/line are copied verbatim; dropped neighbours are never spliced or smoothed
runtimeProbeExpectations.counts: VALUES_TOTAL=<observations before fold>, VALUES_CAPPED=<total-20>; both mandatory when folded; event status TRUNCATED; retained items truncated=false
runtimeProbeExpectations.control: times=5 yields 6 observations -> status OK, no VALUES_CAPPED/VALUES_TOTAL, no fold

chain.flagsRuntimeAssertion: runtime flags may append advisory flags (DROP_COUNT=<n>, S3_RUNTIME_SDK); assert includes('L2') && includes('VALUES_CAPPED') && includes('VALUES_TOTAL') and absence of L1 / LOST_BACKEND / L1_SKIPPED / NO_DEBUG_INFO; never deep-equal arrays and never hard-code the total
chain.noSilentDrop: values.length + VALUES_CAPPED === VALUES_TOTAL (82 dropped + 20 retained = 102 observed)

facts.summary: 发生折叠时事件级 status=TRUNCATED（不是失败、不是 OK；值列表被折叠）
命中 VALUES_TOTAL=102（折叠前真实项数；运行时只断言 t>20，不硬编码 102）
命中 VALUES_CAPPED=82（丢弃数）且 82 = 102 - 20（无静默丢弃）
values 恰 20 项（前 6 + 后 6 + 中段样本 8；保留顺序即观测顺序）
首项保留基线 null→0（第一条观测是基线，不是值变化）
末项保留尾部 49→50（后 6 项保证尾部可见；return 也是 50）
坏值 50→0（from 非空且 to=0）必须优先保留，即使在折叠中段也不能丢
保留项按原观测顺序（不重排）；被丢弃项两侧的 from/to 不被拼接/平滑
保留项 truncated=false：真值未截断，是列表被折叠（UI 不得说成“已截断值”）
折叠不改变真实返回值：100 次循环最终 50
只有 loop service 携带 values；click/fetch/controller 省略该键（graph 呈现 null）
无静默丢弃：20 保留 + 82 丢弃 = 102 观测，计数全部可见

requests.statusRule: existing aggregate priority; TRUNCATED beats RETURNED_FALSE/OK but loses to THREW/UNKNOWN/NOT_COLLECTED_*
requests.nonFoldVariant: times=5 => 6 observations, status OK and no VALUES_CAPPED/VALUES_TOTAL (S6B-C control); reconcileAmount keeps 1/2/1 and no cap flag

graph.sortRule: nodes: startNs ascending, ties by spanId; edges: parent node order then child node order
